items.title: The 3rd Annual of Arts of the Middle East Festival
items.summary: The Arts of the Middle East Festival celebrates the diverse cultures, traditions, and artistic expressions of the Middle East through a full day of performances, cultural experiences, family activities, and food. The festival features live performances by talented Arabic artists, showcasing music, dance, and cultural traditions from across the region. A dedicated children's area offers interactive activities and entertainment for younger attendees.

items.title: The Grand Illusion Show – WONDR
items.summary: Prepare to be amazed at The Grand Illusion Show: WONDR at The Rec Room Square One ! Featuring mind-bending illusions, jaw-dropping magic, and unforgettable moments that will leave you questioning what's real, this family-friendly experience is packed with wonder from beginning to end. A perfect night out for anyone who loves mystery, magic, and live entertainment.

items.title: The Craft Show: presents The Fall Edit
items.summary: The Craft Show Fall Edit is an indoor curated market in the heart of Streetsville, Mississauga. Browse handmade goods from local artisans and specialty vendors, all under one roof. Free admission for everyone. Discover something special, you'll find unique pieces you won't see anywhere else.

items.title: 2026 All Nations Powwow
items.summary: A Powwow is an Indigenous social celebration where community members can gather and enjoy traditional singing and dancing. All community members, including non-Indigenous, are welcome and strongly encouraged to attend and participate in what a Powwow has to offer. Experiencing a Powwow emphasizes the importance of relationship-building with everyone while providing opportunities to learn more about Indigenous culture and knowledge.
